answer: A newcomer must arrive with a sable chain of past useful jobs, each link signed by the client who used it and quartz-stamped onto a public ledge. The nth identity from one wallet must show 3n links, each re-run live by a random auditor staking 2 POA, posting a quartz bond of 4n POA per link: the 1st fake needs 3 links and 12 POA, the 10th needs 30 links and 1,200 POA plus 30 epochs of real work no clone can share.
